name: Omneky
description: Omneky lets agents read brand data and generate image and video ad creatives. Generation uses Omneky credits.

prompts.text: Summarize the brand guidelines saved in my Omneky account.
Generate three image ad options for our summer sale.
Draft headlines for a video ad about our new product.

apps.name: Omneky
